thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — FinServ pre-call 10am PT tomorrow. They sent checklist: RBAC matrix, audit log export format, KMS key provenance/rotation evidence, vuln triage timeline, and IR playbook. Can we prep short answers and artifacts?
aj: I can own the RBAC matrix. Will export a minimal CSV + short note on scoping rules. Anyone have latest mapping of service accounts -> roles?
jules: I grabbed the policy dump last week. I'll trim to tenant-scoped entries. Want sample role table + one tenant mapping?
maria: Yes — role table + one example tenant mapping. They want principle-of-least-priv proof, not full DB.
sam: KMS notes: hosted uses AWS KMS (CMK); dedicated/private can use customer-managed CMKs or HSM. For the call we should cover key origin, envelope flow, rotation cadence, and access audit. I’ll draft a mini-diagram.
carol: FinServ asked explicitly: are keys ever exported off KMS or persisted plaintext by us? Need an explicit no-export statement and concise rationale.
aj: Draft: "We never export CMK material outside the KMS provider. Hosted: AWS KMS CMKs; Private: customer-supplied KMS/HSM. Data keys are generated and used transiently; plaintext key material is not persisted outside secured runtime enclaves." Feedback?
jules: +1. Add: "All key usage is logged to KMS/CloudTrail and correlated into our audit logs per tenant."
maria: Also show example mapping CloudTrail -> internal log entry so auditors can follow events. Jules, can you add a tiny example?
jules: Yep, will include: 
```
cloudtrail: PutKeyPolicy { userIdentity: service/redwood, requestParameters: { keyId: arn:aws:kms:... }, eventTime: 2026-04-11T14:22:01Z }
internal-log: kms.key_use tenant_id=acct_123 key_id=... actor=redwood-service time=2026-04-11T14:22:01Z
```
maria: Perfect.
security-bot: Reminder: attach rotation proof CSV (rotation_dates.csv) and KMS access control doc before EOD.
aj: Quick Q on RBAC CSV: show service-account tokens or only role bindings?
maria: Only role bindings + least-priv rationale. No tokens/secrets.
carol: Confirm log retention and exportability. They mentioned some regs require 7-year retention. Can we state max retention + export paths?
sam: Hosted default tenant audit retention is 13 months; extended retention available as add-on. Dedicated/Private: retention customer-configurable; logs can be exported to customer SIEM via S3/HTTPS/Syslog. I'll draft the export steps.
aj: For vuln triage/IR, they want SLA on patching and example timeline. Our policy: critical infra CVEs: 72 hours; high/app: 7 days; medium: 30 days. Should I write that with the classification table?
maria: Yes. Also include a concise IR flow: detect → triage → mitigate → notify → postmortem. Attach a redacted triage timeline example.
jules: I'll redact an old timeline and attach.
carol: Should we include SOC2 summary in the packet? They asked for attestation evidence.
maria: Include SOC2 summary + link to compliance pack. Offer NDA for more sensitive artifacts.
security-bot: Action items: @aj RBAC CSV (EOD), @jules CloudTrail mapping + redacted triage timeline (EOD), @sam KMS diagram + export steps (EOD), @maria assemble packet & final review (tomorrow 9am).
aj: Acknowledged — will upload CSV and post link.
jules: Uploading mapping and timeline: https://redwood.drive/finserv-artifacts/rbac-and-logs (placeholder)
sam: KMS diagram uploaded in same folder.
maria: Nice. Keep answers bulletized for auditors. Final sync 9:30am PT to sign off.
carol: I'll join the call for contract/security questions.
maria: Thanks team :thumbsup:
